notFound.title: Page Not Found
notFound.description: Sorry, the page you're looking for doesn't exist.

enableEditMode: Enable edit mode to change your password
managePersonalInfo: Manage your personal information and security settings
passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 6 characters.
passwordChangeError: Error changing password. Please try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.newMessageDesc: You have a new message from admin.

variables.title: Message Variables
variables.description: Variables are used in message templates with the format {{name}}. The path indicates where the value is obtained from.
variables.saveProjectFirst: Save the project first to manage variables.
variables.name: Name
variables.nameHelper: Only letters, numbers and _. Must start with a letter.
variables.pathHelper: Path to get the value (e.g.: user.firstName, client.email, lot.number)
variables.noSegments: No fields available at this level
variables.clickToInsert: Click on a variable to insert it into the message
variables.noVariablesYet: No variables defined for this project
variables.goToConfig: Go to project configuration to create variables
variables.confirmDelete: Delete variable "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

mode.title: Recipient Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to send to everyone (General), a specific role, a single user, or multiple users.

title.title: Notification Title
title.description: Write a clear and concise subject. This will be the first thing the user sees.

body.title: Message Body
body.description: Detail the important information. You can use multiple lines for clarity.

type.title: Notification Type
type.description: Select the urgency: Info (Blue), Warning (Orange), Error (Red), or Custom (Purple).

audience.title: Audience Filter
audience.description: This field changes based on the chosen mode. Select the specific roles or users who will receive the message.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: This is how the notification will look on the user's device, with its respective type color.

actions.title: Send Notification
actions.description: Check that everything is correct and click "Send". Recipients will receive it instantly.

header.title: Notification Center
header.description: Here you see a summary of all your alerts. The number next to the title indicates how many notifications you have in total.

tabs.title: Category Filters
tabs.description: Quickly filter by overdue payments, upcoming activities, or stale leads to prioritize your work.

markAll.title: Mark All as Read
markAll.description: Already reviewed everything? Use this button to clear your inbox with a single click.

list.title: Alert List
list.description: Click on any alert to mark it as read. Unread alerts have a colored background to stand out.

footer.title: Real-time Updates
footer.description: This panel updates automatically. Stay on top of critical actions for your projects!

welcome.title: Client Management
welcome.description: From here you can view, search, edit, and manage all residents in the system centrally.

search.title: Smart Search
search.description: Quickly filter the list in real-time by name, email, phone number, or client role.

addAction.title: Add New Client
addAction.description: Click here to register a new resident. A wizard will open to guide you in setting up their data and sending the invitation.

sendMessage.title: Send Bulk Message
sendMessage.description: Use this tool to send SMS or emails to multiple clients simultaneously, using templates or personalized messages.

export.title: Export Data
export.description: Download the client list in CSV or JSON format. You can apply filters before exporting to get only the data you need.

table.title: Data Table
table.description: All clients are listed here. I will explain each column and the actions available in the first row.

colName.title: Name and Email
colName.description: Shows the avatar with initials, full name, and primary contact email.

colPhone.title: Phone
colPhone.description: The formatted phone number. It is the main channel for sending invitations and reminders.

colRole.title: User Role
colRole.description: Indicates the permission level: Super Admin, Admin, Owner, or Resident.

colProjects.title: Assigned Projects
colProjects.description: Shows the real estate projects this client has access to, with a maximum of 4 visible avatars.

colLots.title: Lots/Properties
colLots.description: Number of lots, apartments, or specific properties assigned to the client.

colStatus.title: Account Status
colStatus.description: Indicates whether the client's account is active or inactive in the system.

colJoined.title: Registration Date
colJoined.description: The date the client was created or invited to the system.

colActions.title: Actions Column
colActions.description: Here you will find the buttons to manage the client. I will show them to you one by one in the first row.

actionSms.title: Send Setup SMS
actionSms.description: Click here to resend the password setup link to the client's phone.

actionEdit.title: Edit Client
actionEdit.description: Open the modal to modify the name, email, phone, role, or project assigned to this client.

actionDelete.title: Delete Client
actionDelete.description: Permanently remove the client from the system. You will be asked for confirmation before proceeding.

clickRow.title: View Client Details
clickRow.description: Click on this row (or any other) to open the detailed client view, where you can manage their payments, activities, notes, and documents!

project.title: Link to Project
project.description: Select a project to filter recipients and unlock specific variables for that project (such as lot or building name).

channels.title: Sending Channels
channels.description: Choose whether to send the message via SMS, Email, or both. The system will automatically validate which users have valid data for each channel.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: You can send to all users in the project or select specific recipients using the search.

templates.title: Saved Templates
templates.description: Save time by selecting a predefined template. They will automatically filter based on the selected project.

content.title: Content and Variables
content.description: Write your message. Use the chips above to insert dynamic variables (e.g., {{firstName}}). The preview will show you how the final message will look.

actions.title: Send Message
actions.description: Review the recipient summary at the bottom. When everything is ready, click "Send Message" to start the process.

projectFilter.title: Project Filter
projectFilter.description: Select a specific project to export only the clients associated with it, or leave it on "All" to download the complete database.

format.title: File Format
format.description: Choose the output format. CSV is ideal for opening in Excel, while JSON is useful for technical integrations or backups.

actions.title: Download Data
actions.description: Click the export button to download the file with the filtered data in the format you selected.

header.title: Client Profile
header.description: Here you see the name, account status, and main actions for this resident.

appointment.title: Schedule Appointment
appointment.description: Schedule a meeting or call with this client directly from their profile.

tabs.title: Tab Navigation
tabs.description: All information is organized here. The tour will navigate through each one to show you its content.

overview.title: 1. General Overview
overview.description: Let's click here to view the overview. The tour will show you each section of this tab.

overviewPersonal.title: Personal Data
overviewPersonal.description: Here you see the avatar, email, country, phone, date of birth, and the role assigned to the client in the system.

overviewProjects.title: Related Projects
overviewProjects.description: Shows the client's active memberships, indicating which projects they have access to and with what role (e.g., admin or resident).

overviewStats.title: Financial Summary
overviewStats.description: A quick look at the total properties, accumulated value, amount paid, and outstanding balance for this client.

overviewProperties.title: Assigned Properties
overviewProperties.description: Detailed list of lots or apartments, grouped by project. Includes status, price, balance, and payment progress bar.

payments.title: 2. Payment History
payments.description: Let's click here to explore the financial history. I'll explain its components.

paymentsFilter.title: Status Filter
paymentsFilter.description: Filter payments by status: Pending, Signed, or Rejected to quickly find what you need.

paymentsTable.title: Payments Table
paymentsTable.description: Here you see the details of each installment: payment type, amount, due dates, and current status.

paymentsPagination.title: Pagination
paymentsPagination.description: Navigate between pages or adjust the number of records shown per screen.

activities.title: 3. Activities
activities.description: Chronological record of every interaction: calls, emails, status changes, and team notes.

marker.title: Activity Indicator
marker.description: The color and icon indicate the type of interaction: note, SMS, email, or automation.

card.title: Activity Details
card.description: Here you see the title, full description, and the exact date when the action was recorded.

metadata.title: Contextual Metadata
metadata.description: Shows which project it belongs to, the pipeline column, and the priority level of this task.

users.title: Responsible Parties
users.description: Clearly identify who created the activity and which team member it is assigned to for follow-up.

notes.title: 4. Internal Notes
notes.description: Space to add private observations about the client that only your team can see.

form.title: Add New Note
form.description: Use this form to record internal observations, optionally linking them to a specific project.

card.title: Note Details
card.description: Each note shows its title, full content, and the exact date when it was recorded.

metadata.title: Note Context
metadata.description: Indicates which project or pipeline column this note is associated with, and its priority level.

users.title: Follow-up
users.description: Clearly shows who created the note and which team member it is assigned to for follow-up.

history.title: 5. Change History
history.description: Let's click here to view the complete audit of modifications.

filters.title: Audit Filters
filters.description: Filter changes by action type (create, update, delete) and by date range to find specific events.

table.title: Change Log
table.description: Here you see each modification: who made it, which field changed, the old and new values, and the exact date.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Navigate through the history pages if there are many change records.

documents.title: 6. Documents
documents.description: Let's click here to manage the client's files, contracts, and legal documents.

uploadBtn.title: Upload New Document
uploadBtn.description: Use this button to upload new files, assign them a category, and link them to a specific project.

filters.title: Search Filters
filters.description: Search by name, filter by category (contracts, deeds, blueprints, etc.) or by associated project.

card.title: Document Card
card.description: Each card shows a preview, name, date, and quick actions to preview, view version history, archive, or delete.

finish.title: Explore the Profile!
finish.description: The tour has finished. Now you can freely navigate through all sections to manage this client.

overview.title: Appointment Calendar
overview.description: Here you have a centralized view of all your scheduled appointments, meetings, and calls.

views.title: Calendar Views
views.description: Easily switch between Month, Week, or Day views to organize your agenda according to your needs.

navigation.title: Date Navigation
navigation.description: Navigate forward or backward in time, or return to today with a single click.

create.title: Create New Appointment
create.description: Click here to schedule a new appointment. I will guide you through the creation form.

grid.title: Events Grid
grid.description: Click on any empty day/time to create a quick appointment, or click on an existing appointment to view its details or change its status.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered the calendar. Manage your time and appointments efficiently!

title.title: Title and Status
title.description: Define a clear name for the appointment and its current status (Pending, Confirmed, Completed, or Canceled).

contact.title: Select Contact
contact.description: Choose whether the appointment is with a Lead (prospect) or a Client (resident) already registered in the system.

project.title: Associated Project
project.description: Link the appointment to a specific real estate project to maintain the meeting context.

datetime.title: Date and Time
datetime.description: Set the start date and time. Optionally, define the end time to calculate the duration automatically.

actions.title: Save Appointment
actions.description: Check that all required fields are complete and click "Create" or "Update" to save.

overview.title: Automations Module
overview.description: Here you can create, edit, and manage automated workflows to save time and improve communication.

stats.title: Quick Stats
stats.description: Quickly view the total number of automations created and how many are currently active.

create.title: Create Automation
create.description: Click here to start designing a new automation. I will guide you through the builder step by step.

list.title: Automations List
list.description: Here you will see all your automations. I will explain the components of the first card so you understand how to read them.

card.title: Automation Card
card.description: Each automation is displayed on a card with all relevant information at a glance.

toggle.title: Enable / Disable
toggle.description: Use this switch to pause or resume the automation instantly, without needing to delete it.

header.title: Name and Flow
header.description: Shows the automation name, the event that triggers it, and the action it executes.

conditions.title: Specific Conditions
conditions.description: Summarizes the applied filters, such as lead stage, specific project, or required days of inactivity.

action.title: Action Detail
action.description: Shows the exact content that will be executed: the SMS template message, activity details, or the agent to notify.

footer.title: Additional Information
footer.description: Indicates who created the automation, when it was last executed, and its current status.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered the automations module. Create smart workflows and optimize your CRM!

name.title: Name and Status
name.description: Assign a descriptive name to your automation and define whether it will be active or inactive from the start.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Choose the event that will start this automation (e.g., lead stage change, overdue payment, etc.).

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Refine when it executes. You can filter by specific lead stage, days of inactivity, or a particular project.

action.title: Action to Execute
action.description: Define what will happen when the conditions are met: send an SMS, create an activity, or notify an agent.

config.title: Action Configuration
config.description: Detail the action: select a message template, write a custom message with dynamic variables, or assign the task to an agent.

actions.title: Save and Test
actions.description: Use the "Test" button to simulate the automation. When you are ready, click "Create" or "Update" to save.

overview.title: Campaigns Module
overview.description: From here you can create, manage, and monitor the bulk sending of messages to your leads or clients.

filters.title: Search Filters
filters.description: Filter your campaigns by status (Draft, Sending, Completed, etc.) or by specific project.

create.title: Create Campaign
create.description: Click here to start the campaign creation wizard. I will guide you through its steps.

table.title: Campaigns Table
table.description: All your campaigns are listed here. I will explain the meaning of each column using the first row as an example.

colName.title: Campaign Name
colName.description: The descriptive name you assigned to this campaign to easily identify it.

colStatus.title: Status
colStatus.description: Indicates whether the campaign is in draft, scheduled, sending, completed, or failed.

colAudience.title: Target Audience
colAudience.description: Shows who it is directed to: Leads or Clients, and the applied project or stage filters.

colStats.title: Sending Statistics
colStats.description: Shows the total contacts, how many messages were sent successfully, and how many failed, with a progress bar.

colActions.title: Quick Actions
colActions.description: Edit or delete drafts, send scheduled campaigns, or resend/update campaigns in progress or finalized.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered campaign management. Create your first campaign and measure its impact!

stepper.title: 4-Step Wizard
stepper.description: This wizard guides you sequentially: Configuration, Template, Preview, and Send.

name.title: Campaign Name
name.description: Assign a descriptive name. (In this tour, the system will fill it out automatically).

audience.title: Audience Type
audience.description: Define whether you will send to Leads or Clients. The system will pre-select a test option.

project.title: Project and Stage
project.description: Filter by project and stage to properly segment your audience.

continue.title: Advance to Step 2
continue.description: The system will automatically fill the fields with test data and advance to template selection.

mode.title: Template Mode
mode.description: Choose whether to use an existing template or create a new one. The system has already selected a default one for this demo.

content.title: Content and Variables
content.description: If you create a new one, use the chips to insert dynamic variables (like {{firstName}}) that will be personalized for each contact.

step3.title: Step 3: Preview
step3.description: Here you can see a table with the contacts who will receive the message. Verify that the total and data match your selected audience.

step4.title: Step 4: Confirmation and Send
step4.description: Review the sending status. In this tour, the system will simulate the progress. In a real case, you would launch the campaign here and monitor messages in real-time.

overview.title: Commissions Module
overview.description: Manage, approve, and track your agents' commission payments in one place.

tabs.title: Management Tabs
tabs.description: Navigate between the list of individual commissions and the configuration of commission structures by project.

tabCommissions.title: Tab: Commissions
tabCommissions.description: Here you manage the lifecycle of each commission: from its creation to the final payment.

filters.title: Advanced Filters
filters.description: Refine your search using these filters to quickly find specific commissions.

filterProject.title: Filter by Project
filterProject.description: Filter commissions associated with a particular real estate project.

filterAgent.title: Filter by Agent
filterAgent.description: Search for commissions generated by a specific agent or advisor.

filterStatus.title: Filter by Status
filterStatus.description: Filter by current status: Pending, Approved, Paid, or Disputed.

table.title: Commissions List
table.description: Here you see the breakdown of each commission. I will explain each column below.

colDate.title: Date
colDate.description: The date when the commission was registered or generated.

colAgent.title: Agent
colAgent.description: The name of the agent or advisor who generated the sale and to whom the commission belongs.

colProject.title: Project
colProject.description: The real estate project associated with this sale.

colAmounts.title: Amounts
colAmounts.description: The total sale amount and the specific commission amount to be paid.

colStatus.title: Status
colStatus.description: The current status of the commission approval workflow.

colActions.title: Quick Actions
colActions.description: Buttons to manage the commission. By clicking "Next", we will open the details modal to show you how it works.

tabStructures.title: Tab: Structures
tabStructures.description: Switch to this tab to configure commission calculation rules for each project.

structuresFilter.title: Select Project
structuresFilter.description: First, select a project to view or create its structures. The system will select it for you.

structuresTable.title: Structures Table
structuresTable.description: Here are listed the commission structures configured for the selected project.

structuresColName.title: Name
structuresColName.description: The identifier name of the commission structure.

structuresColType.title: Calculation Type
structuresColType.description: The calculation method: Flat Amount, Percentage, or Tiered.

structuresColDefault.title: Default Structure
structuresColDefault.description: Indicates if this is the default structure that will be applied to new commissions in this project.

structuresColActions.title: Edit
structuresColActions.description: Click here to modify the rules of an existing structure.

createStructure.title: Create Structure
createStructure.description: Click here to configure commission rules. I will guide you through the process.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered commission management. Keep your team motivated with transparent and timely payments!

modal.title: Details Modal
modal.description: This modal allows you to view all the commission information and take actions on it.

overview.title: General Information
overview.description: Here you see the agent, project, sale and commission amounts, as well as any commission splits with other agents.

actions.title: Modal Actions
actions.description: From here you can Approve the commission, Mark it as Paid, or Close the modal to return to the list.

nameType.title: Name and Type
nameType.description: Assign a name to the structure and choose the calculation type: Flat Amount, Percentage, or Tiered.

rates.title: Rates Configuration
rates.description: Define the percentage, flat amount, or tiered ranges according to the selected structure type.

bonus.title: Bonus Rules
bonus.description: Add additional incentives, such as bonuses for fast sales or for exceeding minimum amounts.

actions.title: Save Structure
actions.description: Check that everything is correct and click "Create" or "Update" to save the structure.

overview.title: Quotes Module
overview.description: From here you can create, send, and convert quotes with detailed amortization tables.

stats.title: Quick Stats
stats.description: View the total number of quotes and how many have been sent or converted into sales.

create.title: New Quote
create.description: Click here to start the 3-step wizard. I will guide you through the process.

table.title: Quotes List
table.description: All quotes are listed here. I will explain each column and its actions.

colDate.title: Date
colDate.description: The date the quote was created.

colClient.title: Client or Lead
colClient.description: Shows who the quote is addressed to.

colProject.title: Project
colProject.description: The real estate project the quote belongs to.

colTotal.title: Total Price
colTotal.description: The total amount of the property with the selected customization options.

colStatus.title: Status
colStatus.description: Indicates if it's a draft, sent, accepted, expired, or already converted to a sale.

colActions.title: Actions Column
colActions.description: Here are the buttons to manage each quote. I will explain them one by one.

actionEdit.title: Edit
actionEdit.description: Opens the 3-step wizard to modify the quote details.

actionSend.title: Send Quote
actionSend.description: By clicking "Next", we will open the modal to send the quote via Email or SMS.

actionConvert.title: Convert to Sale
actionConvert.description: By clicking "Next", we will open the modal to convert this quote into a real sale.

actionPdf.title: Download PDF
actionPdf.description: Download the quote in PDF format to share or archive it.

actionDelete.title: Delete
actionDelete.description: Permanently deletes the quote from the system.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered the quotes module. Generate professional proposals and close more sales!

stepper.title: 3-Step Wizard
stepper.description: This wizard guides you sequentially: Property Selection, Financing Configuration, and Preview.

step1.title: Step 1: Property
step1.description: Select the Lead or Client, the project, and the specific property. The system will fill these fields automatically in this tour.

step2.title: Step 2: Financing
step2.description: Define the total price, down payment, interest rate, and term. The system will use test values for this demonstration.

step3.title: Step 3: Preview
step3.description: Review the financial summary and the generated amortization table. You can add notes before saving.

actions.title: Save Quote
actions.description: By clicking "Next", the system will simulate saving and close the modal automatically.

modal.title: Send Modal
modal.description: From here you can send the quote to the client via email, SMS, or both.

method.title: Sending Method
method.description: Select whether you want to send via Email, SMS, or both channels simultaneously.

contact.title: Contact Details
contact.description: The system pre-fills the client's email and phone. You can edit them if necessary before sending.

actions.title: Send
actions.description: Click "Send" to dispatch the quote. The system will automatically mark it as "Sent".

modal.title: Convert to Sale
modal.description: This process transforms the quote into a real sale, creating or linking the property in the system.

info.title: Conversion Summary
info.description: Shows the client, the quoted amount, and whether the property already exists or needs to be created.

actions.title: Confirm Conversion
actions.description: By clicking "Confirm Conversion", the system will link the quote to the property and update the statuses.

overview.title: Vendors Module
overview.description: From here you can manage the complete vendor directory, filtering them by category, project, or scope.

filters.title: Advanced Filters
filters.description: Use the search by name, category, subcategory, project, or scope to quickly find the vendor you need.

grid.title: Vendor Directory
grid.description: All registered vendors are shown here. I will explain the details of the first card.

card.title: Vendor Card
card.description: Each card shows the photo, name, associated project, category, phone, location, and website at a glance.

cardActions.title: Quick Actions
cardActions.description: Use these icons to edit the vendor's information or remove them from the system.

add.title: Add Vendor
add.description: Click here to open the registration form. I will guide you through its fields.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered vendor management. Keep your directory updated to optimize your projects!

overview.title: Vendor Form
overview.description: This modal allows you to register or edit all relevant information of a vendor.

basic.title: Basic Information
basic.description: Define the vendor's name and select their main category and subcategory for proper classification.

contact.title: Contact and Location
contact.description: Add one or more phones, search their address on the map, assign them to a specific project, and add their website.

actions.title: Save Changes
actions.description: Check that all information is correct and click "Save" or "Update" to register the vendor.

overview.title: Documents Module
overview.description: Centralize and manage all files, contracts, and blueprints for your projects and clients in one secure place.

dropzone.title: Quick Upload Zone
dropzone.description: Drag and drop files here directly, or click anywhere in this area to open the upload wizard.

filters.title: Search and Filters
filters.description: Find any document in seconds by filtering by category, project, client, or tags, or use the free text search.

viewToggle.title: View Mode
viewToggle.description: Toggle between a grid view (ideal for seeing details at a glance) or a compact list view for higher information density.

list.title: Documents List
list.description: All documents matching your filters are shown here. I will explain the anatomy of the first card.

card.title: Card Anatomy
card.description: Each card shows: the category icon, the title with its version, a status chip (Valid, Expiring Soon, Expired, or Archived), and its direct relationships with Projects, Clients, or Properties.

actionPreview.title: 1. Preview
actionPreview.description: By clicking "Next", we will open the viewer so you can see the document without needing to download it.

actionHistory.title: 2. Version History
actionHistory.description: Now we will open the side panel to see how the system keeps track of changes and updates to this file.

upload.title: 3. Upload New Document
upload.description: Finally, click here to open the file upload and linking wizard. I will guide you through its fields.

finish.title: Ready!
finish.description: You have mastered document management. Keep your files organized, linked, and always up to date!

dropzone.title: Drag or Select Files
dropzone.description: Drag your files here or click to select them from your device. You can upload multiple documents at once.

basicInfo.title: Basic Information
basicInfo.description: Assign a descriptive title and select the document category (Contract, Deed, Blueprint, etc.).

linking.title: Linking
linking.description: Link the document to a Project, and optionally to a Lead, Client, or a specific property (Lot/Apartment).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Add tags to facilitate searching and, if applicable, set an expiration date for the document.

actions.title: Upload Documents
actions.description: Review that all information is correct and click "Upload" to save the documents in the system.

modal.title: Document Viewer
modal.description: Here you can preview the document content without needing to download it to your device.

content.title: Preview Area
content.description: Supports direct viewing for images and PDFs. For other formats, it will offer the option to open it in a new tab.

actions.title: Viewer Actions
actions.description: Download the file to your computer or open it in a new browser tab for a wider view.

drawer.title: Version History
drawer.description: Keeps a record of all changes and updates to this document over time.

list.title: Version List
list.description: Shows the current version (marked in green) and the archived previous versions, with the date and the user who uploaded them.

upload.title: Upload New Version
upload.description: When uploading a new file, the system increments the version and archives the previous one automatically.

overview.title: Post-Sale Module
overview.description: Manage all post-sale activities: Onboarding, Warranties, and Surveys.

tabs.title: Management Tabs
tabs.description: Navigate between different areas. We will start with Onboarding.

tabOnboarding.title: Tab: Onboarding
tabOnboarding.description: Manage the delivery checklist and onboarding progress for each client.

onboardingFilters.title: Filters
onboardingFilters.description: Filter by project, client, or completion status.

onboardingTable.title: Table
onboardingTable.description: Onboardings are listed here. I will explain its columns.

colProject.title: Project
colProject.description: The real estate project of the delivery.

colStatus.title: Status
colStatus.description: Indicates if it has not started, is in progress, or is completed.

actionView.title: 1. View Details
actionView.description: Opens the modal to review the checklist, notes, and documents.

onboardingNew.title: 4. New Onboarding
onboardingNew.description: Opens the form to create one from scratch.

tabWarranties.title: Tab: Warranties
tabWarranties.description: Let's move on to managing post-sale claims.

warrantiesFilters.title: Filters
warrantiesFilters.description: Filter claims by project, client, status, category, or priority.

warrantiesCreate.title: Create Claim
warrantiesCreate.description: Opens the form to register a new claim.

warrantyColProject.title: Project
warrantyColProject.description: Location of the property under warranty.

warrantyColActions.title: Actions
warrantyColActions.description: Options to view details, resolve, or delete.

warrantyActionView.title: View Details
warrantyActionView.description: Opens the modal to review complete information and resolution actions.

surveysSummary.title: Metrics Summary
surveysSummary.description: Average NPS, overall rating, and total surveys.

surveysFilters.title: Filters
surveysFilters.description: Filter by project, client, type, or template.

surveyColNps.title: NPS
surveyColNps.description: Net Promoter Score (Promoter, Passive, or Detractor).

surveyActionView.title: View Details
surveyActionView.description: By clicking "Next", we will open the modal to view individual responses and comments.

surveyDetailClient.title: Client Information
surveyDetailClient.description: Shows the name of the resident who completed the evaluation.
